utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll coordinate volunteers for tool sorting and the intake table. Sam’s handling the supply list and drop-off setup, so we’re covered there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — once Hana confirms the exact repair drive details, I’ll jump in and help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks, Noah. Once Hana sends the details, I’ll plug you in where we need you most.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Uli — the extension cords would really help, and if you can take a quick look at the side gate latch too, I’d appreciate it. I’m juggling school pickup, so I may be a little tied up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — do you want me to bring the extension cords now, and should I check the latch before or after pickup?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Before pickup would be best, if that works for you. Thank you — I’m trying to keep things around the school schedule, so I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Eli’s coming at 9:00 a.m. with gloves, a screwdriver, and a few spare screws. I’d still ask everyone to bring sturdy gloves, a screwdriver, and any spare screws they have for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. I’ll ask around for a ladder and drill too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Gus—that’d be great. I’ll keep asking folks to bring sturdy gloves, a screwdriver, and any spare screws for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’d like to know the schedule and the exact repair location first. Once that’s clear, I can see what I can help with.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it — I’m keeping the supplies list handy, so once we know the schedule and location, I’ll note anything still missing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps. If Nell can check the exact times and location, I can plan around it once we have those details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ve got Eli and Rosa on my list, and I’ll share the time as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep repeating the plan to folks once the time’s set.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks Vik — I’ll spread the word too once we have the time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, I’m on it—I can help sort the donations and load the boxes. Rey’s bringing the screwdriver and extra tape, so we should be all set.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it — I can swing by later and drop something off.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Ira — that helps a lot. I’ll handle the supply list and drop-off setup, and Vik will go over the plan at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll be there at 9:00 a.m. with sturdy gloves, a screwdriver, and a few spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I’ve got you on the calendar for 9:00, and I’ll save Dane a spot when he gets here. Thanks for bringing the drill and screwdrivers too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Glad to help, Mara. I’ll bring the gloves, a screwdriver, and the spare screws at 9:00.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to make sure I have the repair-drive details right first—can you confirm which spots are still needed? Once I’ve got that, I can loop Noah in to help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll bring a screwdriver and extra tape for the repair drive. I’m not sure which spots are still needed, though.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’m still checking the list, and Opal has the repair-drive locations. Once I confirm the needed spots, I’ll loop Noah in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, Mara’s keeping the repair drive on the calendar, right? And Gus can lend tools if we need them?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, keep it simple and we’re still taking whatever folks can spare. Ira can drop something off later if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just confirming: Mara’s got it on the calendar, and Gus can lend tools if needed, right?

utterances.speaker: Uli

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll bring the drill and a few screwdrivers and help sort the donated tools when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Uli

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ll ask around for a ladder and a good drill, and I’ll let you know what I find. Once you’ve got the schedule and location, I can pass that along too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll be there at 9:00 a.m. with sturdy gloves, a screwdriver, and any spare screws I can find for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules

utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ll head straight to the tool sorting area when I arrive at 9:00 a.m. and bring those supplies for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah

utterances.speaker: Dane

utterances.speaker: Ira

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d help, thanks — I still need the exact time and where the repairs are happening before I can plan.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll check in and get the exact time and spot for you, then I’ll bring something by later.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ve got the supply list and drop-off setup covered, so I’ll make sure that part runs smoothly. If you need anything else, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thanks Sam — I’ll get Rosa’s details over to you soon, and I’ve already got Eli on the invite list. I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Quinn — once you send Rosa’s details, I’ll add them to the supply list and keep the drop-off setup ready. Appreciate you spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oren’s already in, and Vik said he’ll spread the word. We still need hands for sorting donations and loading boxes, so every bit helps.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. And if you need it, Nell can ask around for a ladder and drill.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be a huge help, Gus—thanks. If Nell can round up the ladder and drill, I’ll keep the word moving for the sorting and box loading too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Keep it simple—whatever folks can spare helps, and Cleo’s got the supplies list. Ira can drop something off later if that works.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good—I’ll pass that along and keep it simple for folks. If I hear from anyone with extra, I’ll point them to Cleo’s list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Vik—that works. Just send anyone with extras to Cleo’s list, and we’ll take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help for a bit today. I’ll bring the extension cords, sort through the donated tools, and take a quick look at the side gate latch.

utterances.speaker: Oren

utterances.speaker: Uli

utterances.speaker: Rey

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to confirm the repair-drive details first, then I can map out the spots we still need. If Opal has the location list, I can check it and let Noah know when we’re set.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’m set for the 9:00 a.m. repair drive, and I’ll bring sturdy gloves, a screwdriver, and a few spare screws. Just let me know when you’ve got the location list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, I’ve got your 9:00 a.m. note and supplies. I’ll check with Opal for the location list, then I can map the remaining spots and let Noah know we’re set.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ve got the repair drive on the calendar, and I’ll save Dane a spot when he gets here. He said he’d bring a drill and a few screwdrivers, so we’re set.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just to confirm—we’re still good on the repair drive, right? And you’ll check in with the others if anything changes?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — Quinn can put my name down and bring me the details. I’m happy to help get the repair drive word out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll keep the supplies list updated and note anything still missing. Mina’s bringing duct tape, zip ties, and spare screws, so I’ll watch for any gaps.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — thanks, Cleo. Keep me posted on any gaps, and I’ll help spread the word.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
